about_the_game:
This game is a third-person perspective Warriors and Action Game game.

The player takes the role of a drill alien and controls a dog to defeat the Antenna Aliens, a hostile force.

The enemies are attacked by the Antenna Aliens and animals controlled by the Antenna Aliens.

At the end of the area, a boss character, a giant animal, awaits and attacks the player.

Will you be able to defeat the hostile Antenna aliens and restore peace to the drill aliens?

In this demo version, you can play the early stages of “Wan Drill”.

---------------------

Players take on the role of a Drill Alien, controlling a dog to confront the hostile Antenna Aliens and the animals under their control.

Contents playable in the demo version:

One stage as a tutorial

Available actions: Drill attack, Drill rolling, Poop bomb, Pee attack

Can battle with zombie enemies along the way and one boss (giant animal)

Basic reinforcement elements and object destruction can also be experienced

Wan Drill” is a musou action game that combines drills, dogs and silly gags from a third-person perspective. A total of 5 areas of battles and even more diverse action await you in the full version.
